CustomField.description: Any accounts with a contract renewal date before this threshhold will automatically be prioritized. If left blank or set to zero, contract renewal dates will not be factored into prioritization. Any records with blank contract renewal dates will be ignored, regardless of this setting.

CustomField.label: Contract Renewal Threshhold
